construct_validity_correction: PREVENT blocks x during the one intended causal exposure; after lag 1 x is removed from both TRANSIENT and PREVENT.
intervention_timing: At the frozen checkpoint, FORCE-derived branches receive x as occupied and PREVENT remains x-empty. Intervention delivery is external and does not consume a lag-1 evaluation slot. No ordinary loss occurs before the first causal growth exposure.
probe_support: x is still selected from the checkpoint's exact finite-budget evaluated candidate set using the same first-exposure input.
lag1_control: During lag 1 growth PREVENT removes x from the frontier before finite-budget selection; FORCE-derived branches contain x as an occupied neighbour. Ordinary loss follows growth.
transient_equalization: Immediately after lag 1 growth+loss, x is explicitly removed from both TRANSIENT and PREVENT and absence is asserted.
later_x_semantics: From lag 2 onward no branch specially blocks x. Natural reoccupation is downstream dynamics and x remains excluded from outcome accounting.
retained_semantics: RETAINED means x is not experimentally removed after the intervention. It is not clamped occupied and remains subject to ordinary loss/reoccupation.
critical_reference: Only transient G(30) is compared descriptively with 1.
primary_inference_uses: group means; probes within one checkpoint are repeated measures
validity_assertions: FORCE x present before lag-1 growth
PREVENT x blocked from lag-1 frontier before selection
PREVENT x not attached at lag 1
x absent from TRANSIENT and PREVENT after lag-1 cleanup
